recentItems.title: Dirty Bomb Alarm In Washington, Behind Iran's Terrifying Weapon That Even Left US Intel In Panic
recentItems.description:
A major intelligence revelation has come to the fore, and it could expose a terrifying new dimension of the ongoing US-Iran war. According to a new American intelligence assessment reported by cnn, Iran may be exploring plans to strike Washington DC using a radioactive dirty bomb. And the potential targets are not military bases, naval installations or oil infrastructure. They reportedly include senior officials of the Trump administration, right inside the American capital. If these intelligence concerns prove credible, the implications could be extraordinary. Because Washington may not be looking at another conventional military attack involving Iranian missiles or drones. It could be facing the possibility of an unconventional weapon designed to spread radioactive contamination, trigger mass panic and disrupt the functioning of America's political heartland. But what exactly is a dirty bomb? Is it a miniature nuclear weapon or something more sinister? And most importantly has Iran actually developed such a device? Or could radioactive material already be present inside the United States? Well come along and watch this edition of From The News Desk till the end as we understand what a dirty bomb actually is, examine what US intelligence has reportedly discovered, and revisit the British cases that explain why radioactive and chemical weapons have become such a serious security concern.
